decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module that fits the firm's modular sensing platform, its market potential is still uncertain and there is no evidence yet that justifies abandoning the option after only one year.
Because it is the new generation replacing an earlier voltage measurement module, it is a core platform product and should be retained unless clear failure emerges, which is not yet visible.
The MQTT proxy extends the software and connectivity side of the ecosystem, and as a low-cost option to keep open it should remain on the market while demand information is still developing.
A CAN bus interface strengthens the platform's industrial and embedded use cases, and with only launch-year information there is too much unresolved upside to drop it now.

The carbon dioxide sensor module is closely aligned with the firm's measurement and automation customers, so management would keep this young product while its adoption potential is still being learned.
Even if demand may be narrower for a touch panel accessory, it complements the modular hardware range and there is not enough negative evidence after one year to warrant exit.
